shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '35,145p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md; printf '\\n--- theming reference ---\\n'; sed -n '1,220p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md; printf '\\n--- project ---\\n'; cat package.json; printf '\\n--- app ---\\n'; cat src/App.tsx; printf '\\n--- main ---\\n'; cat src/main.tsx; printf '\\n--- installed uikit ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | sed -n '1,80p'"

/bin/bash -lc ".agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider Switch Text || true; printf '\\n--- theme types ---\\n'; rg -n \"ThemeContext|theme=(\\\"|\\')|ThemeProviderProps|value=.*theme|setTheme|SwitchProps\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -80; printf '\\n--- docs theming ---\\n'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides 2>/dev/null || true"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts; printf '\\n--- provider d.ts ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts; printf '\\n--- switch d.ts ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts; printf '\\n--- online docs: theme switcher ---\\n'; curl -fsSL https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt | rg -i -n -C 3 \"theme switch|useThemeContext|systemLightTheme|ThemeProvider\" | head -120"
/bin/bash -lc 'command -v apply_patch || find / -name apply_patch -type f 2>/dev/null | head; git diff --stat; cat src/App.tsx'
